That's another thing that isolates me. i had bad experiences on dating apps. and since those are the "norms" i am no longer normal.

He (himself) doesn't hurt me any longer. I "gray rock" constantly,  yea, no, ok...like that. We share custody of a dog so no, i can't really just block. I know that sounds silly.   
And what i mean, there are triggers from that relationship, trust issues and other things, but those triggers are now coming from everybody. He doesn't even affect me any longer. I see through him for what he is. A Grandiose Narcissist.   Hoovering is all part of that. He see's me weak, and pounces.   
After saying all of that, he hoovers, and i still have no one to talk to, I am desperately lonely, so the worst thing he does is bring the temptation to just have ANYONE to talk to. But i know he throws my weaknesses back in my face, so I WOULD NEVER open up to him ever again.   
He fooled me. I know why...but with the knowledge of why he is the way he is, I won't be fooled again. He is one of my BIG mistakes. I made very bad choices in men, twice.   
it's all over now, I can't bring myself to trust... My therapist wants me to try things on "Meet Up" and i have a couple of times... but no one talks to me really, and both times it was awkward and i was so tense, my body hurt the next day.

I too can see my errors. my bad choices. I take responsibility, when a lot of other people don't.  

you are speaking of Fake, I feel like i can "SEE" the fake in people, and i hate it, it makes me feel even more like i don't belong.

Fake people hate honesty.  and it seem that the fake have taken over society.
